title: Poor Quality and Bad Fit.
text: Poor Quality and Bad Fit.. Extremely disappointing. Fit was bad and kept falling off. Much too thin and ripped quite easily. Purchased with cart as an accessory. Cart is great liner is not worth even the $7 bucks! Go elsewhere for the liner.
